name: PivotFormula
description: Represents a formula used to calculate results in a PivotTable report.
remarks: This object and its associated properties and methods aren't available for OLAP data sources because calculated fields and items aren't supported.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Formula
properties.description: Returns or sets a String value that represents the object's formula in A1-style notation and in the language of the macro.

properties.name: Value
properties.description: Returns or sets a String value that represents the name of the specified formula in the PivotTable formula.

properties.name: Index
properties.description: Returns or sets a Long value that represents the index number of the PivotFormula object within the PivotFormulas collection.

properties.name: StandardFormula
properties.description: Returns or sets a String specifying formulas with standard English (United States) formatting. Read/write.
